## Activity

During December 2023, North City Eye Clinic completed 484 captures. Activity was delivered as part of the clinic’s routine service, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance during the month.

## Image quality

Graders recorded 10 ungradable sets from the 484 captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 2.1 per cent of all captures. The result should be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention given to image acquisition and any recurring factors affecting whether images can be assessed. No additional operational disruption was reported in relation to the sessions.

## Grading

A total of 116 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3 days. This indicates that grading activity continued alongside image capture and that results were processed within the reported service timeframe. The referable results and grading lag should continue to be reviewed through standard performance monitoring, alongside the ungradable rate, to support consistent delivery at North City Eye Clinic.
